paper.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
truncated_sections: B.5 Performance Variance and Pass@k Rate

result.summary: 本文提出 SWE-agent，一个由语言模型（LM）与 agent-computer interface（ACI）组成的系统，用于自主解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。作者认为 LM agent 是一类新的终端用户，需要专门设计的接口，因此设计了包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件的 ACI [S2.p1][S3.p1]。在 SWE-bench 和 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 分别取得 12.5% 和 87.7% 的 pass@1 成绩，超过此前非交互式 LM 的最佳结果 [abstract]。消融实验表明，ACI 设计选择对性能有显著影响，例如 SWE-agent 比仅使用 Linux shell 的基线多解决 10.7 个百分点 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：如何设计 LM agent 与计算机交互的接口，以提升其在软件工程等复杂任务上的表现 [S1.p1]。作者指出，现有接口（如 Linux shell）是为人类用户设计的，LM agent 在使用时容易出错且缺乏有效反馈，因此需要专门为 LM 设计的 agent-computer interface [S1.p2]。作者认为 LM agent 代表一类新的终端用户，具有自身需求与能力，研究接口设计对其性能的影响具有重要性 [S2.p1]。

evidence.quote: we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.

These deficits substantially hamper performance, motivating the need for an agent-computer interface (ACI), i.e., an abstraction layer between the LM agent and computer, to enhance the LM agent’s abilities in computer environments
We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.

method.text: 论文提出 SWE-agent，一个由 LM 和 ACI 组成的系统，使 LM agent 能够自主使用计算机解决软件工程任务 [S1.p3]。其 ACI 包含搜索/导航、文件查看器、文件编辑器和上下文管理等组件，提供一组简单动作，并配有 guardrails 和简洁反馈 [S3.p1][S1.p3]。设计遵循四条原则：动作简单易懂、动作紧凑高效、环境反馈信息丰富但简洁、guardrails 缓解错误传播 [S2.p5]。作者通过手动检查 agent 行为和网格搜索来选择最佳 ACI 配置 [S2.p4]。

evidence.quote: we introduce SWE-agent, an agent composed of an LM and ACI, that can interact with a computer to solve challenging real-world software engineering problems
The ACI comprises several principal components, including search/navigation, file viewer, file editor, and context management.
The ACI uses guardrails to prevent common mistakes, and an agent receives specific, concise feedback about a command’s effects at every turn.
1. Actions should be simple and easy to understand for agents.
2. Actions should be compact and efficient.
3. Environment feedback should be informative but concise.
4. Guardrails mitigate error propagation and hasten recovery.

We use two approaches to enhance performance on a development set: (1) manually inspect agent behavior to identify difficulties and propose improvements, and (2) run a grid search to select the best ACI configuration.

experiments.text: 论文主要在 SWE-bench 数据集上评估，该数据集包含来自 12 个 Python 仓库的 2,294 个任务实例；消融和分析在 SWE-bench Lite（300 个实例）上进行，并使用 HumanEvalFix 测试基本代码编辑能力 [S4.p1]。实验使用 GPT-4 Turbo 和 Claude 3 Opus 两个 LM [S4.p2]。基线包括非交互式检索增强生成（RAG）和仅使用 Linux shell 的 Shell-only 设置 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。主要指标为 % Resolved 或 pass@1，并报告平均 API 成本，每实例预算设为 4 美元 [S4.p5]。

evidence.quote: We primarily evaluate on the SWE-bench dataset, which includes $2,294$ task instances from $12$ different repositories of popular Python packages.
SWE-bench Lite is a canonical subset of $300$ instances from SWE-bench that focus on evaluating self-contained functional bug fixes.
We also test SWE-agent’s basic code editing abilities with HumanEvalFix, a short-form code debugging benchmark.
All results, ablations, and analyses are based on two leading LMs, GPT-4 Turbo ( gpt-4-1106-preview) and Claude 3 Opus ( claude-3-opus-20240229).
The first setting is the non-interactive, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) baselines established in.
The second setting, called Shell-only, is adapted from the interactive coding framework introduced in.
We report % Resolved or pass $@$ $1$ as the main metric, which is the proportion of instances for which all tests pass successfully after the model generated patch is applied to the repository.
Due to budget constraints, we set the per-instance budget to $4; if a run exceeded this budget, existing edits were submitted automatically.

findings.text: SWE-agent 搭配 GPT-4 Turbo 在完整 SWE-bench 测试集上解决 12.47%（286/2,294），在 Lite 上解决 18.00%（54/300），在所有系统中表现最佳 [S5.p1]。相比 Shell-only，SWE-agent 相对提升 64% [S5.p1]。在 HumanEvalFix 上，SWE-agent 取得 88.3% 的 pass@1 [S5.p2]。消融实验显示，迭代搜索界面因 agent 穷举查看结果反而比无搜索工具更差（15.7% vs 12.0%）[S5.SS1.p3]；无文件编辑器时性能降至 10.3% [S5.SS1.p4]；加入 linting 干预后性能提升（无 linting 时为 15.0%）[S5.SS1.p5]。行为分析发现，agent 通常先复现或定位问题，随后进入“编辑-执行”循环 [S5.SS2.p2][S5.SS2.p3]；51.7% 的轨迹出现至少一次编辑失败，单次失败后最终成功概率从 90.5% 降至 57.2% [S5.SS2.p4]；成功运行比失败运行更早、更便宜地结束 [S5.SS2.p5]；约一半未解决实例属于错误实现或过度特定实现 [S5.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: Across all systems, SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo achieves the best performance all-around, successfully solving $12.47$ % ( $286$ / $2,294$) of the full SWE-bench test set and $18.00$ % ( $54$ / $300$) of the Lite split.
An LM-friendly ACI’s value is confirmed by SWE-agent’s $64$ % relative increase compared to Shell-only, both with GPT-4 Turbo.
In Table 3, SWE-agent yields strong performance on HumanEvalFix with $88.3$ % pass@1 rate.

Without SWE-agent’s file editor interface, performance drops to ( $10.3$ % $\downarrow$ 7.7).
This intervention improves performance considerably (without linting, $15.0$ % $\downarrow$ 3.0).
SWE-agent usually begins with either writing reproduction code and/or localizing the issue’s cause to specific lines of code.
Remaining turns are mostly “edit, then execute" loops.
out of $2,294$ task instances, $1,185$ ( $51.7$ %) of SWE-agent w/ GPT-4 Turbo trajectories have $1$ + failed edits.
Any attempt at editing has a $90.5$ % chance of eventually being successful. This probability drops off to $57.2$ % after a single failed edit.
We observe that successful runs complete earlier and at a cheaper cost than unsuccessful ones.
